name: prompt-translator
description: Translate prompts before Claude Code using an OpenAI-compatible API or local Codex CLI.

backend.title: Translation backend
backend.description: Choose api for an HTTP endpoint or codex-cli for your local Codex login. You can change this later in /config or /plugin configure.

language.title: Target language
language.description: Both backends: en: English; jp: Japanese; cn: Simplified Chinese; fr: French. Controls prompt translation and replies.

codex_path.title: Codex executable
codex_path.description: Codex CLI backend only. Leave codex to use PATH, or enter an executable's absolute path without arguments. Uses Codex's saved login and model configuration.

api_url.title: API URL
api_url.description: API backend only. Complete OpenAI-compatible chat/completions URL. Ignored in codex-cli mode.

model.title: Translation model
model.description: API backend only. Model ID accepted by your translation API. Codex CLI uses its own model configuration.

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: API backend only; leave empty for codex-cli. Saved in secure storage. Alternatively use TRANSLATOR_API_KEY in the environment or plugin .env.

reasoning_effort.title: Reasoning effort
reasoning_effort.description: API backend only. Use low for the default GLM model, or default to omit this field. Codex CLI uses its own reasoning configuration.
